shortDescription: HONG KONG, Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Raytech Holding Limited (the “Company”) NASDAQ:RAY today announced that it plans to change its English name from “Raytech Holding Limited” to “Atlas Trinity Tech Limited” and its Nasdaq ticker symbol from “RAY” to “ATTT” (collectively, the “Corporate Ev…

The Company anticipates that the Corporate Events will become effective upon the commencement of trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market on or around September 10, 2026 (U.S. Eastern Time). At that time, the Company’s ordinary shares are expected to cease trading under the current ticker symbol “RAY” and begin trading under the new ticker symbol “ATTT.” The Corporate Events are part of the Company’s strategic development plan.
The Company will issue a further announcement once the effective date of the Corporate Events has been confirmed.

is a Hong Kong-based holding company with over 10 years of experience in the personal care electrical appliance industry. The Company operates three businesses through its operating subsidiaries in Hong Kong: (i) the sourcing and wholesaling of personal care electrical appliances for international brand owners, ranging from hair styling, trimmer, eyelash curler, and nail care to other body and facial care appliances, conducted by Pure Beauty Manufacturing Company Limited; (ii) the provision of product design and development services and project advisory services in relation to personal health care electronics, conducted by Raytech Innovation Limited; and (iii) the provision of marketing solutions services, conducted by Worry free Group (Hong Kong) Limited.
